name: useHealthConnect
summary: Health Connect availability and the device's step counter and heart rate sensors. Does not read health records.
plain: Tells you whether Health Connect looks available on the device and whether the phone has a step counter and heart rate sensor. It does not read steps, heart rate or any Health Connect record.
description: isAvailable and sdkStatus are inferred: the healthconnect system service (Context.HEALTHCONNECT_SERVICE, Android 14+) or the com.google.android.apps.healthdata package is present. They are not the result of HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus(), which this SDK does not call, so no provider-update state is reported. hasStepCounter / hasHeartRateSensor and the sensor names come from the step counter system feature and SensorManager.getDefaultSensor (TYPE_STEP_COUNTER, TYPE_HEART_RATE).

returns.name: isAvailable
returns.desc: Inferred: the healthconnect system service or the com.google.android.apps.healthdata package exists.

returns.name: sdkStatus
returns.desc: 'SDK_AVAILABLE' when isAvailable, otherwise 'SDK_UNAVAILABLE'. Not read from HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus(); no provider-update state is reported.

returns.name: hasStepCounter
returns.desc: Whether physical hardware step counter sensor is present.

returns.name: hasHeartRateSensor
returns.desc: Whether hardware heart rate sensor is present.

returns.name: stepSensorName
returns.desc: Hardware sensor name (e.g. Google Step Counter).

returns.name: isFrameworkIntegrated
returns.desc: Whether the healthconnect system service exists (Android 14+).

returns.name: refresh
returns.desc: Re-probe Health Connect framework and hardware sensors.

actions.name: refresh()
actions.desc: Re-probe Health Connect framework and hardware sensors.
